steps.en: Install VS Code from the download page or your package manager
steps.zh: 从下载页或包管理器装上 VS Code

steps.en: Open your project folder from the terminal
steps.zh: 在终端里打开项目目录

steps.en: Install the extension for your language or framework
steps.zh: 装上对应语言或框架的扩展

steps.en: Runs the extension in its extension host, which starts the language's tooling
steps.zh: 在扩展宿主里运行扩展，由它拉起该语言的工具链

steps.en: Serves completion, go-to-definition, inline errors and debugging in the editor
steps.zh: 在编辑器里提供补全、跳转定义、行内报错和调试

value.en: One editor and one set of keybindings for every language, with capabilities added per project by extensions
value.zh: 一个编辑器、一套快捷键覆盖所有语言，能力按项目靠扩展补上

sources: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode README (fetched 2026-10-08): Code - OSS vs Visual Studio Code distribution under the Microsoft product license; download for Windows, macOS and Linux; built-in extensions provide language features
https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/command-line (fetched 2026-10-08): open a folder with `code .`; --install-extension takes the full extension name publisher.extension
https://code.visualstudio.com/api/advanced-topics/extension-host (fetched 2026-10-08): the Extension Host is responsible for running extensions; local, web and remote extension host kinds
